RRVUNL JE / Other Posts Exam Date 2026 – Full Details

Rajasthan Rajya Vidyut Utpadan Nigam Ltd (RRVUNL) has released the Exam Date for the post of Junior Engineer, Junior Assistant. This recruitment was released for 2005 posts. Applications for the RRVUNL JE / Other Posts Online Form 2026 were accepted from 05 August 2026, to 31 August 2026. The Exam is going to conducted on Candidates must check the complete details for RRVUNL JE / Other Posts Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 04 August 2026
  • Application Start Date : 05 August 2026
  • Last Date : 31 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 31 August 2026
  • JE (Electrical) Exam Date : 29-30 November 2026
  • JE (Mechanical) Exam Date : 30 November 2026
  • JE (Civil) Exam Date : 30 November 2026
  • Jr Assistant/CA Exam Date : 04, 05, 08, 19, 20 & 22 December 2026 & 01 January 2027
  • Junior Accountant Exam Date : 13 & 15 January 2027
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, Other State : 1000/-
  • SC, ST, EBC, MBC, BC, EWS : 500/

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
